prompt: Review SoFi's causal relationship to digital finance and crypto rails.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: SoFi's integrated brokerage, crypto, payments, deposits and Galileo infrastructure could convert migration toward digital financial rails into more products per member, fee revenue and infrastructure economics.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if digital-product adoption fails to improve consolidated per-member economics, regulatory costs overwhelm fee gains, or Technology Platform contraction prevents infrastructure monetization.
